messages:
nina: Quick Q for folks starting today 1: where should I drop common setup issues vs team questions? Also getting a lot of CI pings.

leo_it: Welcome Nina! Short guide: 
- Hardware / VPN / SSH: post in #help (infra) or DM me for priority.
- HR / benefits / badge: DM @carla_peopleops or use the People Ops portal.
- Product/code questions: post in your team channel (e.g., #eng).
- General newbie stuff: keep it in #new-hires so others can learn.

nina: How do I mute the CI/deploy notifications without missing alerts?

leo_it: Two options: 1) Channel level -> Notifications -> Mute. 2) For bot subscriptions, open the bot message that set it up and click "unsubscribe" or run `/deploy-bot unsubscribe` in that channel. If you need pages preserved, keep @oncall unsubscribed off.

setup-bot: Onboarding checklist updated for nina: VPN profile generated; SSO ok; enroll in 2FA.

carla_peopleops: Also, please post a 1-line intro in #introductions using: `Name | Team | TZ | Pronouns | 1-line what I'm working on`. We pin the best ones.

nina: Awesome, thanks! One more 1: preferred threading etiquette?

leo_it: Reply in-thread for the same question. Start a new message if it's a different topic. Helps keep channels tidy. :sparkles:
